Preserve the original answer. Unanswered learning questions do not block an otherwise correct implementation; actual code defects remain normal implementation findings. No extra learner-written tests or documents are required to answer.

## Review

- [ ] Criteria demonstrated with reproducible behavior/experiments; any test-writing feedback is optional.
- [ ] Implementation completion is judged against the original bounded goal; learning gaps are recorded separately without surprise product requirements.
- [ ] The change adds a distinct product capability and reuses accepted units.
- [ ] Reciprocal review completed; only Prem-Tomar merges.
- [ ] Prerequisites are reviewed in order, and feedback follows the mandatory summary/inline review format.
- [ ] No secrets or real customer data.
